name: Alley Catgirl
description: Prowls the fire-escape network at midnight. Trades secrets for tuna and eye contact.

card.subtitle: Fire-Escape Regular

ability.name: Trade Secrets
ability.text: Knows which windows are unlatched and who left them that way. Tells you for the price of tuna.

card.flavorQuote: Look up. She has been there the whole time.

buddyBonus.name: Trash Treasure
buddyBonus.flavorText: Trash Treasure: +10% chance to find items from Hunting.

name: Shrine Assistant
description: Sweeps the stone steps at dawn. Bows perfectly. Blushes even more perfectly.

buddyBonus.name: Offering Bowl
buddyBonus.flavorText: Offering Bowl: +50% Affection gained.

name: Café Maid
description: Draws hearts in your latte foam. Refills are complimentary. Restraint is not.

buddyBonus.name: Second Cup
buddyBonus.flavorText: Second Cup: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Neon School Rebel
description: Blazer half-unbuttoned, tie loose, LED nails already breaking dress code.

buddyBonus.name: After Bell
buddyBonus.flavorText: After Bell: +8% capture chance against SR and below Waifumon.

name: Library Goth
description: Reads forbidden poetry between the shelves. Marks her page with black lace.

buddyBonus.name: Quiet Study
buddyBonus.flavorText: Quiet Study: +25% Essence gained.

name: Arcade Bunny
description: Trades her tickets for winks. The claw machine is never actually rigged for her.

buddyBonus.name: Free Play
buddyBonus.flavorText: Free Play: 5% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Rainy Day Idol
description: Practices choreography in an empty station platform. Her umbrella is optional.

buddyBonus.name: Soft Spotlight
buddyBonus.flavorText: Soft Spotlight: +10% encounter weight for human Waifumon.

name: Sleepy Succubus Intern
description: First week on the job. Still forgetting to hide her tail during the video call.

buddyBonus.name: Power Nap
buddyBonus.flavorText: Power Nap: +50% Affection gained.

name: Nurse Imp
description: Prescription: bedrest and hand-holding. She'll administer both personally.

buddyBonus.name: "What's in tha-...OW!"
buddyBonus.flavorText: "What's in tha-...OW!": 5% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Streetwear Oni
description: Cropped hoodie, single horn poking through a beanie. Skates louder than she talks.

buddyBonus.name: "Do a Kickflip!"
buddyBonus.flavorText: "Do a Kickflip!": +25% Essence gained.

name: Moonlit Dancer
description: Bare feet on cool marble. Her wings drift like slow smoke around her.

buddyBonus.name: Night Floor
buddyBonus.flavorText: Night Floor: +10% encounter weight for angel Waifumon.

name: Cyber Neko
description: Purr indistinguishable from a cooling fan. Runs firmware updates while she naps on you.

buddyBonus.name: Street Pounce
buddyBonus.flavorText: Street Pounce: +10% encounter weight for demi-human Waifumon.

name: Potion Shop Clerk
description: Recommends the 'confidence' tonic. Insists it is definitely not a love potion. Winks.

buddyBonus.name: Under the Counter
buddyBonus.flavorText: Under the Counter: +25% Essence gained.

name: Velvet Bartender
description: Slides you something red that is definitely just wine. Probably. Enjoy the ambiance.

buddyBonus.name: Last Call
buddyBonus.flavorText: Last Call: +25% Essence gained.

name: Demon Hall Monitor
description: Enforces the dress code with tail flicks and clipboard checks. No running in her hallway.

buddyBonus.name: Detention List
buddyBonus.flavorText: Detention List: +10% encounter weight for dominant affinity Waifumon.

name: Beachside Siren
description: Sings quietly to the surf. Sunscreen application is a group activity around her.

buddyBonus.name: Luring Song
buddyBonus.flavorText: Luring Song: +8% capture chance against SR and below Waifumon.

name: Neon Kitsune Apprentice
description: Only three tails so far, and each one already causing a small blackout.

buddyBonus.name: First Trick
buddyBonus.flavorText: First Trick: +12% encounter weight for spirit Waifumon.

name: Crimson Oni Bride
description: Kimono soaked in dusk. She has already picked out a ring. It is very heavy.

buddyBonus.name: Bride's Claim
buddyBonus.flavorText: Bride's Claim: +12% Player XP gained.

name: Cyber Shrine Maiden
description: Prays in the server room. The lanterns are LEDs. The blessings are real.

buddyBonus.name: Sacred Maintenance
buddyBonus.flavorText: Sacred Maintenance: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Latex Paladin
description: Vows of protection, oiled plate armor. Her halo hums when she means it.

buddyBonus.name: Oathbound
buddyBonus.flavorText: Oathbound: +10% capture chance against demon Waifumon.

name: Gothic Vampire Heiress
description: The estate is hers. The nights are longer here. She insists you stay for tea.

buddyBonus.name: Eternal Mark
buddyBonus.flavorText: Eternal Mark: +50% Affection gained.

name: Hologram Idol
description: Encore performance in a rainy alley, for an audience of one. Signal quality is perfect.

buddyBonus.name: Fan Light
buddyBonus.flavorText: Fan Light: +50% Affection gained.

name: Demon Librarian
description: The forbidden section is under her personal supervision. Glasses slip when she leans in.

buddyBonus.name: Demonic Rolodex
buddyBonus.flavorText: Demonic Rolodex: +12% encounter weight for demon Waifumon.

name: Bunny Dealer
description: Shuffles a deck one-handed. The house always wins, but she might lose on purpose.

buddyBonus.name: Gambler
buddyBonus.flavorText: Gambler: +10% capture chance against unowned species.

name: Angelic Delinquent
description: Halo tilted. Skirt shortened. Wing feathers dyed at the tips. Detention forever.

buddyBonus.name: Tough Love
buddyBonus.flavorText: Tough Love: +12% encounter weight for submissive affinity Waifumon.

name: Witchy Mechanic
description: Tunes engines with sigils and swearing. Her broom has a working exhaust.

buddyBonus.name: Big Wrench
buddyBonus.flavorText: Big Wrench: +10% capture chance against android Waifumon.

name: Void Catgirl
description: Purrs from an empty room. Eyes reflect a sky that isn't yours.

buddyBonus.name: "Swipe!"
buddyBonus.flavorText: "Swipe!": +40% eligible rewards from Boss Encounters.

name: Royal Succubus
description: Kneeling is optional. Bowing is expected. Her court runs on velvet and consent.

buddyBonus.name: Royal Privilege
buddyBonus.flavorText: Royal Privilege: 8% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Chrome Valkyrie
description: Chassis polished to a mirror. Chooses her hunters based on their reflection.

card.subtitle: Mirror Finish
card.flavorQuote: She picked you before you saw her.

buddyBonus.name: Overclock
buddyBonus.flavorText: Overclock: 8% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Blood Moon Priestess
description: Chants under a red sky. The offerings are wine. The wine is not wine.

buddyBonus.name: Blood Offering
buddyBonus.flavorText: Blood Offering: +40% XP gained by the active Buddy.

name: Casino Kitsune
description: Nine tails, each holding a different chip. The dealer never checks her sleeves.

buddyBonus.name: High Roller
buddyBonus.flavorText: High Roller: +15% encounter weight for unowned species.

name: Fallen Angel Nurse
description: Grounded her wings for the graveyard shift. Her bedside manner still saves souls.

buddyBonus.name: Night shift
buddyBonus.flavorText: Night shift: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Dollhouse Demon
description: Porcelain smile, silk ribbons, a very tidy shelf of past hunters.

buddyBonus.name: Wind up
buddyBonus.flavorText: Wind up: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Darkelf Royal
description: Royal blood, midnight skin, eyes that pierce through the veil of night.

buddyBonus.name: Royal Favor
buddyBonus.flavorText: Royal Favor: +12% capture chance against SSR+ Waifumon.

name: Queen of Velvet Chains
description: Every chain is negotiable. Every negotiation ends her way. She always leaves the key on the table.

buddyBonus.name: Willing Chains
buddyBonus.flavorText: Willing Chains: +15% capture chance against dominant affinity Waifumon.

name: Neon Dragon Empress
description: Scales like circuit boards, breath like a spotlight. Ruled a skyline for a century already.

buddyBonus.name: Digital Hoard
buddyBonus.flavorText: Digital Hoard: +18% chance to find items from Hunting.

name: Eclipse Idol
description: Only performs when the sun goes dark. The stadium fills with candles and hush.

buddyBonus.name: Encore
buddyBonus.flavorText: Encore: +18% encounter weight for owned species.

name: Abyssal Shrine Oracle
description: Speaks with something older than the shrine itself. Her sleeves drip when there is no rain.

buddyBonus.name: Twisted Blessing
buddyBonus.flavorText: Twisted Blessing: +15% capture chance against primal affinity Waifumon.

name: Afterglow Goddess
description: The light that lingers after the good part is over. Mortals build shrines to a single warm breath.

buddyBonus.name: Aftercare
buddyBonus.flavorText: Aftercare: +75% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Cyber Lilith Prime
description: First of her line. Her firmware wrote itself. Her firewalls flirt back.

buddyBonus.name: Hijack
buddyBonus.flavorText: Hijack: +18% capture chance against any Waifumon.

name: The First Waifu
description: The one every other Waifumon remembers a little. Older than the archetypes. Fond of hunters who ask her name twice.

buddyBonus.name: Unconditional Love
buddyBonus.flavorText: Unconditional Love: +100% Affection gained.

name: The Waifu Below
description: The dark side of the perfect Waifu. A goddess? maybe. An interesting time, obviously.

buddyBonus.name: Soul Claim
buddyBonus.flavorText: Soul Claim: +25% encounter weight for SSR+ Waifumon.

name: Neko Barista
description: Serves lattes with a mischievous smile and suspiciously perfect foam art.

buddyBonus.name: Warm Refill
buddyBonus.flavorText: Warm Refill: 5% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Gym Oni
description: Will spot your bench press. Will not spot your escape.

buddyBonus.name: Spotter
buddyBonus.flavorText: Spotter: +25% XP gained by the active Buddy.

name: Library Ghost
description: Shushes you from between the stacks. Cold hands, warm heart.

buddyBonus.name: Unlisted Title
buddyBonus.flavorText: Unlisted Title: +10% encounter weight for unowned species.

name: Arcade Succubus
description: Holds every high score. Feeds on continues.

buddyBonus.name: Free Play
buddyBonus.flavorText: Free Play: +10% capture chance against any Waifumon.

name: Ramen Android
description: Optimized broth algorithms. Steam vents are strictly decorative. Probably.

buddyBonus.name: Extra Serving
buddyBonus.flavorText: Extra Serving: +30% Essence gained.

name: Neon Kitsune
description: Nine tails, each glowing a different shade of trouble.

buddyBonus.name: FoxFire
buddyBonus.flavorText: FoxFire: +15% encounter weight for unowned species.

name: Eclipse Valkyrie
description: Descends only when the moon covers the sun. Chooses her hunters carefully.

buddyBonus.name: Warpath
buddyBonus.flavorText: Warpath: +18% Player XP gained.

name: Void Empress
description: Reality bends politely out of her way. You should too.

buddyBonus.name: Inevitability
buddyBonus.flavorText: Inevitability: +75% Affection gained.

name: After Hours Caretaker
description: Keeps the lights low after closing. Somehow always knows who needs a softer touch.

buddyBonus.name: The Naughty Shift
buddyBonus.flavorText: The Naughty Shift: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Android Assassin
description: Footsteps muted, optics locked, lips curved like the final warning you missed.

buddyBonus.name: Clean Kill
buddyBonus.flavorText: Clean Kill: +10% capture chance against any Waifumon.

name: Android Secretary
description: Schedules meetings, files secrets, and adjusts her glasses when protocols get personal.

buddyBonus.name: Filed Under "You"
buddyBonus.flavorText: Filed Under "You": +10% encounter weight for owned species.

name: Angelic Judge
description: Weighs every sin with merciful eyes and a verdict that still makes knees weak.

buddyBonus.name: Verdict
buddyBonus.flavorText: Verdict: +30% eligible rewards from Boss Encounters.

name: Archangel Inquisitor
description: Carries holy questions on a silver tongue. Lies burn faster when she smiles.

buddyBonus.name: Holy Audit
buddyBonus.flavorText: Holy Audit: +10% capture chance against SSR+ Waifumon.

name: Bimbo Valkyrie
description: Descends from battle glittering, giggling, and somehow still holding the sharpest spear.

buddyBonus.name: Pretty Spear
buddyBonus.flavorText: Pretty Spear: +10% encounter weight for SR Waifumon.

name: Cabaret Star
description: Owns the spotlight before the curtain rises. Every encore sounds like a dare.

buddyBonus.name: Encore Crowd
buddyBonus.flavorText: Encore Crowd: +12% capture chance against SR and below Waifumon.

name: Cat Burglar
description: Slips through skylights for jewels, secrets, and the occasional stolen kiss.

buddyBonus.name: Quiet Hands
buddyBonus.flavorText: Quiet Hands: +12% chance to find items from Hunting.

name: Dragon Casino Queen
description: Stacks chips like treasure and watches the table fold beneath her golden stare.

buddyBonus.name: House Edge
buddyBonus.flavorText: House Edge: +12% chance to find items from Hunting.

name: Feral Android
description: Built for obedience, rewired by instinct, and growling softly at every command.

buddyBonus.name: Broken Protocol
buddyBonus.flavorText: Broken Protocol: +10% capture chance against android Waifumon.

name: Feral Wood Spirit
description: Bare feet in moss, teeth in moonlight, and flowers blooming where she hunts.

buddyBonus.name: Wildpath
buddyBonus.flavorText: Wildpath: +15% encounter weight for spirit Waifumon.

name: Heaven's Spear Marshal
description: Commands the sky-lances with polished wings and absolutely no patience for hesitation.

buddyBonus.name: Divine Mandate
buddyBonus.flavorText: Divine Mandate: +18% encounter weight for demon Waifumon.

name: Holy Courtesan
description: Blesses the lonely with silk, incense, and prayers whispered dangerously close.

buddyBonus.name: Sacred Softness
buddyBonus.flavorText: Sacred Softness: +50% Affection gained.

name: Lantern Spirit
description: Follows lost travelers through fog, glowing warmer when they say her name.

buddyBonus.name: Light the way
buddyBonus.flavorText: Light the way: +10% chance to find items from Hunting.

name: Leopard Bodyguard
description: Walks one step behind you, watching every exit and every fool who stares too long.

buddyBonus.name: Escort Duty
buddyBonus.flavorText: Escort Duty: +25% eligible rewards from Boss Encounters.

name: Neko Tattoo Artist
description: Inks charms with a purring focus, then dares you not to flinch.

buddyBonus.name: Returning Customer
buddyBonus.flavorText: Returning Customer: +8% capture chance against owned species.

name: Owl Detective
description: Solves cases after midnight, blinking slowly at lies until they confess themselves.

buddyBonus.name: Investigator
buddyBonus.flavorText: Investigator: +10% encounter weight for SR Waifumon.

name: Phantom Violinist
description: Plays for empty balconies. The living still leave roses by morning.

buddyBonus.name: Lingering Note
buddyBonus.flavorText: Lingering Note: +12% Player XP gained.

name: Queen of the Wild Hunt
description: Rides ahead of the storm, laughing as the forest chooses her prey.

buddyBonus.name: Horn Call
buddyBonus.flavorText: Horn Call: +20% encounter weight for SSR+ Waifumon.

name: The Crimson Judge
description: Her red mask never moves. Her sentence always arrives before the blade.

buddyBonus.name: Blood Docket
buddyBonus.flavorText: Blood Docket: +50% eligible rewards from Boss Encounters.

name: The Crown of Humanity
description: The essence of humanity through the ages.

buddyBonus.name: Magnetism
buddyBonus.flavorText: Magnetism: +25% encounter weight for human Waifumon.

name: Thot chat 2.0
description: Flirts in push notifications and somehow passes every Turing test with extra credit.

buddyBonus.name: Suggested for you
buddyBonus.flavorText: Suggested for you: +10% encounter weight for android Waifumon.

name: Valkyrie Recruit
description: Still polishing her armor, already picking fights bigger than her wingspan.

buddyBonus.name: Prove Yourself
buddyBonus.flavorText: Prove Yourself: +25% XP gained by the active Buddy.

name: Winged Waitress
description: Balances trays, halos, and terrible customers with a smile sharpened to perfection.

buddyBonus.name: "On the House"
buddyBonus.flavorText: "On the House": +25% eligible rewards from Boss Encounters.

name: Your Favorite Girl
description: Shows up exactly your type, then pretends that was a coincidence.

buddyBonus.name: Already Yours
buddyBonus.flavorText: Already Yours: +10% capture chance against owned species.

name: Couch-Surfing Valkyrie
description: Sleeps on the shrine's back-room couch since her hall disbanded and stopped paying. Keeps the spear within reach, and her half of the couch free for whoever asks nicely.

card.subtitle: Out of Service

ability.name: Couch Privileges
ability.text: The shrine couch is hers, and she will share it with anyone who asks. Rest with her and Care mode gives back far more Energy.

card.flavorQuote: Stay as long as you like. I'm not going anywhere.

buddyBonus.name: Crash Space
buddyBonus.flavorText: Crash Space: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Festival Stall Android
description: Runs a yakisoba stall through the whole summer festival. Feeds you before you have finished deciding, and remembers what you liked.

card.subtitle: Seconds, Always

ability.name: Extra Portion
ability.text: Keeps a portion back for anyone who comes around twice. Leave her counter fed and you find more out in the valley.

card.flavorQuote: You look hungry. Sit. I'll decide what you're having.

buddyBonus.name: Free Sample
buddyBonus.flavorText: Free Sample: +10% chance to find items from Hunting.

name: Konbini Android
description: Works the overnight counter at the valley's 24-hour store. Scans, bows, follows the till, and does not stop smiling at you until you leave.

card.subtitle: Two Sizes Too Small

ability.name: Do As Told
ability.text: Follows the till, the queue and you, in that order, and never quite switches off. Keep her on shift and the valley treats you better.

card.flavorQuote: Welcome in. Take your time. I'm not going anywhere until six.

buddyBonus.name: Night Shift
buddyBonus.flavorText: Night Shift: 8% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Courier Android
description: Runs every alley in the valley on a fixed route in bike shorts. Will not stop. Will slow down.

card.subtitle: Route Optimized

ability.name: Priority Drop
ability.text: Sets the pace, keeps the route and never misses a door. Keep her running the valley and the good ones always find you first.

card.flavorQuote: Will not stop. Will slow down.

buddyBonus.name: Fixed Route
buddyBonus.flavorText: Fixed Route: 5% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Backroom Angel
description: Runs the private back room of the valley's lounge, where the real deals get made. The halo is the only straight thing in the room.

card.subtitle: House Rules

ability.name: House Cut
ability.text: Runs the back room where the valley's real deals get made, and remembers every favour owed. Keep her close and the rarer ones come to you first.

card.flavorQuote: Sit down. The room already knows what you want.

buddyBonus.name: House Rules
buddyBonus.flavorText: House Rules: 10% higher capture chance on encounters she watches.

name: Heatwave Spirit
description: The valley's worst week of summer, given a body and a very thin slip. She hangs above the ruined steps, hunting whatever is coldest.

card.subtitle: Worst Week of Summer

ability.name: Heat Haze
ability.text: The worst week of summer with a woman's shape and an appetite for anything cold. She finds the shade before you need it, and she never lets the day cool down.

card.flavorQuote: Bring something cold. I have all week.

buddyBonus.name: Cold Spot
buddyBonus.flavorText: Cold Spot: 10% higher item find chance on hunts while she drifts with you.

name: Landlady Slumlord
description: Runs the valley's cheapest rental block, four floors of peeling paint and one working washing machine. Rent is due weekly, and she takes it however she needs to.

card.subtitle: Rent's Due

ability.name: Weekly Collection
ability.text: Owns and runs the cheapest rental block in the valley, and always collects. Rent is due every week, and she decides what counts as payment.

card.flavorQuote: Rent's due. Pay me however you like — I'll decide if it counts.

buddyBonus.name: Weekly Collection
buddyBonus.flavorText: Weekly Collection: +25% Essence gained.

name: Festival Lance
description: Carnival lancer. Rides the festival circuit, wins the tilt, keeps the ribbon.

card.subtitle: Keeps the Ribbon

ability.name: Tilt Winner
ability.text: Takes the tilt more often than she loses it, and every ribbon in her tent is one she won. Keep her riding with you and the better matchups come to you.

card.flavorQuote: I keep the ribbon. You can keep the memory.

buddyBonus.name: Circuit Champion
buddyBonus.flavorText: Circuit Champion: +12% encounter weight for unowned species.

name: Oathbound Valkyrie
description: Bound by oath to whoever holds her token, and currently looking for whoever holds it.

card.subtitle: Whoever Holds It

ability.name: Oath Keeper
ability.text: Sworn to whoever carries her iron token, and still looking for them. She keeps the oath, the ropes and the patience for whoever turns up holding it.

card.flavorQuote: The oath is already sworn. Only the hand is missing.

buddyBonus.name: Sworn Devotion
buddyBonus.flavorText: Sworn Devotion: 50% more affection gained while she is bound to you.

name: Valley Enforcer Unit
description: Mall security for the valley's shopping block. Riot plating under the uniform, a stun baton on her hip, an incident log in her hand, and a standing order to escort you out personally.

card.subtitle: Escorted Out

ability.name: Standing Order
ability.text: Runs the mall's night detail and writes up everything. She has decided how your evening ends; the only question is whether you walk out or get walked out.

card.flavorQuote: You can walk, or I can walk you.

buddyBonus.name: Confiscated Goods
buddyBonus.flavorText: Confiscated Goods: 30% more boss rewards while she secures the area.

name: Iron Circuit Trainer
description: Programmed to take you to failure, then past it. Counts your reps out loud and does not accept the word stop.

card.subtitle: Past Failure

ability.name: Rep Count
ability.text: Iron-circuit gym unit: she sets the weight, counts the reps out loud and takes you past where you would have stopped. Under her, levels come faster.

card.flavorQuote: Ten more. I'll count.

buddyBonus.name: Trainer's Regimen
buddyBonus.flavorText: Trainer's Regimen: 30% more Buddy XP while she trains you.

name: Dojo Headmistress
description: Runs the valley's one dojo and takes all comers. Does not stop the bout when you tap.

card.subtitle: One More Round

ability.name: Open Dojo
ability.text: Runs the valley's only dojo and fights anyone who steps onto her floor. She calls the round and decides when it ends; tapping out only buys you another one.

card.flavorQuote: You tapped. I did not stop.

buddyBonus.name: Open Mat
buddyBonus.flavorText: Open Mat: +15% encounter weight for human Waifumon.

name: Halfling Cavalry
description: A three-foot lancer on four hundred pounds of war-ram. She takes the front rank personally; the ram takes it literally.

card.subtitle: First In, Last Paid

ability.name: Ram Charge
ability.text: Three feet of knight on four hundred pounds of argument. She takes the front rank, lets the ram settle the rest, and the horned helmet never comes off.

card.flavorQuote: Three feet of knight. Four hundred pounds of argument.

buddyBonus.name: First In
buddyBonus.flavorText: First In: +10% capture chance against R and below Waifumon.

name: Android Maid
description: A short-stacked service chassis keeping a big empty house. She holds every room to a standard no human could, and she does not sleep.

card.subtitle: Rounds at Six

ability.name: House Protocol
ability.text: Built for the house and nothing but it. The evening round ends, the apron comes off, and she waits to be told what else needs doing.

card.flavorQuote: The house is spotless. You are the last thing in it that isn't.

buddyBonus.name: Housekeeping
buddyBonus.flavorText: Housekeeping: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Prototype Zero
description: The first combat frame off the line, walking a high valley at golden hour with her rifle slung and her plates cut away. She is not on patrol; she is deciding whether to be.

card.subtitle: First Off the Line

ability.name: Prototype Frame
ability.text: Built as the baseline for everything perfect: seams showing, serial under the collarbone. Every android here is a copy of her frame, and she knows it.

card.flavorQuote: Everything after me was a copy.

buddyBonus.name: Frame Recognition
buddyBonus.flavorText: Frame Recognition: +25% encounter weight for android Waifumon.

name: Valkyrie Prime
description: The first of them. Every oath in the valley descends from her, whether or not the oath-taker knows it.

card.subtitle: Every Oath Descends From Her

ability.name: Prime Oath
ability.text: The oath she swore on that hill, back when she was mortal, is the root of every oath the valley's valkyries still swear. She has never come down the steps.

card.flavorQuote: Every oath in this valley started as mine.

buddyBonus.name: Prime Command
buddyBonus.flavorText: Prime Command: +20% encounter weight for valkyrie Waifumon.

name: Cyberpunk Knight
description: Scavenged plate over a nano-weave bodysuit, a monomolecular longsword over her shoulder and a circuit-wolf on her pauldron. She holds the corner of the arcology the corps stopped paying to repair.

card.subtitle: Scavenged Knight

ability.name: Monoedge
ability.text: Took the knight's shape off a dead feed: sigil on the pauldron, banner on the rail. The block respects a heraldry it cannot afford, so she keeps it.

card.flavorQuote: The corps stopped patching this block. I kept it.

buddyBonus.name: Scavenger's Walk
buddyBonus.flavorText: Scavenger's Walk: +15% chance to find items while hunting.

name: The Innkeeper
description: The valley's only human innkeeper. Has hosted every legend in this file, and remembers all of them.

card.subtitle: Everyone Signs the Book

ability.name: The Guest Book
ability.text: Every legend in the valley has slept under her roof and signed her ledger — the valkyries, the machines, the things that came down out of the rift. She remembers what each of them drank, who they arrived with and what they still owe, and she has never once sold a page of it.

card.flavorQuote: Everyone signs the book. Everyone comes back.

buddyBonus.name: Stories of Every Guest
buddyBonus.flavorText: Stories of Every Guest: +18% player XP.

name: Summer Storm Spirit
description: The storm that ends the valley's summer festival every year, on time, whether or not anyone is ready.

card.subtitle: On Time, Every Year

ability.name: Festival's End
ability.text: She comes up out of the thunderhead over the festival lane as a shape before she is a body, and by the time she has finished making herself a woman of storm the lanterns are out and the stalls are down. She keeps the same appointment every summer, to the hour, whether or not the valley is ready for her.

card.flavorQuote: Pack up. I am on time.

buddyBonus.name: Charge the Air
buddyBonus.flavorText: Charge the Air: 8% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Lake Lifeguard
description: Keeps the public lake beach in order from a tower, a whistle and forty degrees of pure conviction. Has never once had to swim out.

card.subtitle: Never Had To Swim Out

ability.name: Rope Line
ability.text: She does not patrol the rope line so much as stare it into place - whistle in her mouth, hands on her hips, one eyebrow raised. In eleven summers nobody has needed rescuing, which she takes as proof the whistle works and never as luck.

card.flavorQuote: Back by sundown. You'll hear the whistle.

buddyBonus.name: Lost and Found
buddyBonus.flavorText: Lost and Found: +12% chance to find items from Hunting.

name: Bathhouse Valkyrie
description: Keeps the valley's bath house: scrubs, pours, and throws people out. Gives orders in the steam room and takes them behind the curtain.

card.subtitle: The Water Runs Both Ways

ability.name: House Rules
ability.text: She holds the door, the bucket and the timetable, and expects to be obeyed for it - until she hands the cloth over and expects to be handled instead. She has never needed the word please in either direction.

card.flavorQuote: Pick up the bucket. I'll tell you when to stop.

buddyBonus.name: Trade Places
buddyBonus.flavorText: Trade Places: +12% capture chance against switch affinity Waifumon.

name: Ice House Android
description: Keeps the valley's cold store under the ice house: everything in the valley stays on ice until it is asked for, and she keeps the ledger of what is owed.

card.subtitle: Nothing Moves Until She's Told

ability.name: Standing Order
ability.text: She will hold any position in the cold store for as long as she is left to hold it, and she has never once taken the initiative. Ask her for something and she does exactly that much of it and no more, then stands and waits with her hands at her sides for the next instruction.

card.flavorQuote: Say it, and I'll do it. Only that.

buddyBonus.name: Everything On File
buddyBonus.flavorText: Everything On File: +12% to world encounter checks.

name: Ferry Angel
description: Poles the valley's river ferry from first light to last, and will not put in for the night while anyone is still standing on the far shore.

card.subtitle: Nobody Left On The Far Shore

ability.name: The Last Crossing
ability.text: She runs the ferry until the last lamp is lit and will not tie up for the night with anyone left waiting on the far side of the water. Cross with her once and the pace of the crossing is hers to set - she poles, you sit, and the river does the rest of the work.

card.flavorQuote: Sit down. I pole, you ride.

buddyBonus.name: Carried Across
buddyBonus.flavorText: Carried Across: 8% chance Hunting does not consume Energy.

name: Pilgrim's Rest Angel
description: Keeps the valley's rest house for travellers who arrived too late to go further: a register at the door, a bed down the row, and one lamp carried from room to room at closing.

card.subtitle: The Last Room In The House

ability.name: Last Lamp
ability.text: She walks the corridor at closing with one lamp and puts every room to bed in turn, and she will not turn the last lamp down while a single door is still open. Nothing that reaches her door is refused a bed, and nothing in her house is done in a hurry.

card.flavorQuote: The door's open. Come in and I'll shut it.

buddyBonus.name: Bed and Board
buddyBonus.flavorText: Bed and Board: +50% Energy gained in Care mode.

name: Fallen Valkyrie
description: Ruined and drinking. Lives on the valley's low road with a bottle and no hall to go back to, in tarnished plate with pieces missing and a circlet worn crooked.

card.subtitle: Her Road, Her Rules

ability.name: Last Call
ability.text: She has not been up to the hall in years and has no intention of being asked. Whatever the valley sends down the low road gets looked over once, priced, and either drunk with or sent back the way it came.

card.flavorQuote: It's my road. Sit down or keep walking.

buddyBonus.name: Bottom Shelf
buddyBonus.flavorText: Bottom Shelf: +25% Essence gained.
